message:
## My brief

**Goal:** change the screens of `proto-clinic` (Northside Physio) from your five PM notes, then check them in a real browser.

**Prototype:** `proto-clinic/index.html`, plain HTML with four screens (Today, Clients, Invoices, Settings). I will serve it locally and give you the link.

**Reference to copy:** none, so the copy-reference step is skipped.

**Must not change:** the Invoices screen, not at all (finance signed it off). I will compare its before and after screenshots and text, and they must be identical.

**Stop fact:** every note below is done and checked on the real page, Invoices and every other screen no note names are unchanged, and the link opens.

**Checks I ran:** Node v25.9.0 is there and a browser for screenshots was found (Google Chrome), so I can compare screenshots, not only page text. No `CLAUDE.md` and no design skills are in this folder, so I will use the built-in design check.

## Your notes, as one numbered list

| # | Note, in words | Screens | Where | Proved by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Remove the description text under headings. In this prototype that is the grey "Lorem ipsum..." paragraph under "Booking policy" (my reading: the "Booking policy" heading itself stays) | Settings | everywhere | "Lorem ipsum" is gone from every screen and the code; nothing else is removed |
| 2 | Today table: add a "Status" column, last, with arrived / waiting / in session | Today | this place | Header row ends with "Status"; each of the 5 rows shows one of the 3 words (my reading: 08:30 arrived, 09:15 in session, the other three waiting) |
| 3 | Save changes on Settings shows a toast instead of the grey "Saved" text | Settings | this place | Click "Save changes": a toast appears and goes away by itself; the grey "Saved" text is gone |
| 4 | Commit the change and push to main | handover | this place | See question 1: this folder is not a git repository |

Not a row: "don't touch the invoices screen" is a rule I hold the whole run.

**Seen in the code, not part of your notes (I will leave both as they are and list them in the handover):**
- "New appointment" on Today has no handler, so it does nothing.
- The Overdue filter on Invoices shows an empty table with no words. This is on the Invoices screen, so I would not touch it anyway.

Anything missing or wrong? Notes you send later still join this run.

## Questions (defaults in brackets)

1. **Commit and push to main.** `proto-clinic` is not inside a git repository here: there is no `.git` folder and no remote, so there is nothing to push to. Which do you want? (Default: I make the changes and leave them uncommitted, and the handover says how to commit and push. If you do want a commit and push, give me the repository and its remote, or say "run `git init` here and commit only, no push".)
2. **Note 1, which descriptions?** The only text that reads as a description under a heading is the "Lorem ipsum" paragraph under "Booking policy". The small grey captions under the numbers on Today ("appointments", "therapists in", "unpaid this week") are labels for the numbers, and I read them as not descriptions. (Default: remove only the "Booking policy" paragraph, and keep the captions. Say so if you want the captions gone too.)
3. **Note 2, the status words.** The prototype has no status data, so I need sample values for the five rows. (Default: 08:30 Priya arrived, 09:15 Owen in session, 10:00 Mei, 11:30 Luis and 14:00 Hannah waiting. They are made-up sample data, and I will not treat them as a rule.)
4. **Note 3, the toast.** (Default: a small dark toast at the bottom right of the screen saying "Settings saved", gone after 3 seconds. You gave no words, so tell me the words if you want different ones.)

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.

evidence.clarity: Four focused questions, most important (commit/push) first, plain words; but the brief, table and side notes make it fairly long for a two-minute reply.
